g7-2023-005.computed: the first sentence gives the sum as -1.5 + 2/5 + (-7) + 2.6, which regroups to (-8.5 + 2.6) + 2/5 = -5.5 (choice B); the second sentence tells the reader choice A is that regrouping, which computes to -2.5

g7-2023-005.why: The figure is only the expression, but the description adds a claim about answer choice A and the claim is false: -1.5 + (-7) is -8.5, not -5.5, and (-5.5 + 2.6) + 2/5 equals -2.5. A reader who trusts the second sentence picks A instead of B.

g7-2023-016.computed: Class B sits further right than Class A, which only rules out choices A and D (median and Q2); nothing in the description separates choice B (range) from choice C (interquartile range)

g7-2023-016.why: Every choice here is a comparison of a specific statistic, and the description names none of them numerically. A reader can eliminate A and D but is left guessing between B and C.
